# Boston Design Guide

> > Boston Design Guide showcases architecture, interior design, and artisan craftsmanship across Boston, Cape Cod, and New England.

Published by Melanie Perillo, Boston Design Guide features residential and commercial design projects, designer profiles, and industry insights from leading architects like Nicholaeff Architecture + Design, luxury brands including Sub-Zero and Wolf, and local artisans. The guide covers everything from Cape Cod coastal architecture to custom furniture making and sustainable design practices.

## Key Topics

- Cape Cod Architecture
- Boston Area Design
- Custom Furniture & Woodworking
- Sustainable Luxury
- Kitchen & Bath Design
- Landscape & Water Features
- Home Office Design
- Outdoor Living Spaces
- Theatre & Nonprofit Renovation
- Craftsman Profiles
- Sub-Zero & Wolf Appliances
- New England Residential Design
- Coastal Home Design
- Design-Build Projects
- Artisan Collaboration

## Interior Design & Home Spaces

- [Home Office Designs for Every Taste](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/home-office-designs-every-taste): Showcase of custom home office designs by Boston area designers
- [Inviting Kitchens: 5 Warm and Welcoming Designs](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/inviting-kitchens-5-warm-and-welcoming-designs): Showcase of cozy kitchen designs by Venegas & Jennifer Palumbo
- [Thinking Outside the Box with Smart Storage Solutions](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/thinking-outside-box-smart-storage-solutions): Roomscapes showcases custom cabinetry & kitchen storage solutions
- [Sustainable Luxury at Artefact Boston](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/sustainable-luxury-artefact-boston): Boston Design Week 2019 panel on sustainable luxury at Artefact's showroom
- [Dowel Furniture Debuts New Collection with Interior Designer Duncan Hughes](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/dowel-furniture-debuts-new-collection-interior-designer-duncan-hughes): Dowel Furniture launches Duncan Hughes collaboration at Las Vegas Market

## Craftsman & Artisan Profiles

- [Talking Shop with Ray Bachand of 60nobscot](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/talking-shop-ray-bachand-60nobscot): Profile of craftsman Ray Bachand's custom furniture & woodworking studio
- [Portrait of a Photographer: Roger Pelissier](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/portrait-photographer-roger-pelissier): Profile of Wellesley portrait photographer Roger Pelissier's studio work
- [In Studio with Architect John Battle: Two Creative Spaces](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/studio-architect-john-battle-two-creative-spaces): Battle Associates designs recording & ceramics studios for artists

## Outdoor Living & Landscape Design

- [The Benefits of A Backyard Water Feature: A Deep Dive with FallingWater Scapes](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/benefits-backyard-water-feature-deep-dive-fallingwater-scapes): FallingWater Scapes discusses landscape water features & sustainable design
- [It's High Time for the Terrace!](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/its-high-time-terrace): Outdoor living & terrace design inspiration from Boston area designers
- [The Right Mix: A Front Walk Makeover](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/right-mix-front-walk-makeover): Plymouth Quarries transforms Cohasset home with granite & brick hardscape

## Cape Cod & Coastal Architecture

- [Only on the Cape! Five Feel-Good Scenes](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/only-cape-five-feel-good-scenes): Showcase of Cape Cod coastal architecture & waterfront home designs

## Renovation & Transformation Projects

- [Art Imitates Life: Inside AD's Rehearsal Building Renovation](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/art-imitates-life-inside-ads-rehearsal-building-renovation): Architectural Design Inc. transforms Elements Theatre rehearsal building
- [Garage Door Transformation](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/garage-door-transformation): Garage Headquarters transforms Medfield home with carriage-style doors

## Showroom Features & Industry Events

- [Following Melanie: Out & About @7 Tide](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/following-melanie-out-about-7-tide): Publisher Melanie Perillo tours Clarke's 7 Tide Boston Seaport showroom
- [Snow and Jones Hosts Showroom Addition Soiree Cocktail Party](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/snow-and-jones-hosts-showroom-addition-soiree-cocktail-party): Snow and Jones unveils new showroom featuring ROHL, KOHLER luxury fixtures
- [CLARKE's Fresh Freight Farm Celebrates First Harvest](https://www.bostondesignguide.com/blog/clarkes-fresh-freight-farm-celebrates-first-harvest): Clarke's Sub-Zero/Wolf showroom launches hydroponic container farm
